Chapter 01 About

Technical foundation with field awareness.

My portfolio connects subsurface interpretation, field data quality, and practical survey workflows. It is built for geophysicist, field engineer, geophysical survey, wireline, and geosolutions trainee opportunities.

I am a Geophysical Engineering graduate from Institut Teknologi Bandung. My academic work focused on sandstone reservoir characterization in the Talang Akar Formation, South Sumatra Basin, using well log review, seismic interpretation, and seismic inversion workflows.

I also have exposure to marine geophysical methods and land seismic data preparation. I enjoy work that requires careful documentation, disciplined quality control, and the ability to translate field records into reliable technical outputs.

Technical focusSeismic interpretation, inversion, well log review, and reservoir property estimation
Survey focusSide scan sonar, sub bottom profiler, bathymetry concept, and acquisition data readiness
Working styleCalm, documentation oriented, careful with technical assumptions, and ready for field routines

Chapter 03 Selected Projects

Three projects with clear technical outputs.

Each project is structured from context to deliverable, with images stacked vertically to preserve natural proportions and avoid empty image frames.

Seismic conditioning review and reservoir property visualization for Talang Akar sandstone interpretation.

Low Quality Reservoir Characterization Talang Akar

Short context

Reservoir characterization study in the Talang Akar Formation, South Sumatra Basin, focused on intervals where sandstone, shale, and hydrocarbon responses are difficult to separate.

What I worked on

Reviewed well logs, interpreted seismic horizons, checked conditioned seismic response, evaluated low impedance behavior, and interpreted channel geometry indications.

Technical workflow

Well log review, seismic conditioning review, well to seismic tie, sensitivity analysis, horizon interpretation, general seismic inversion, and reservoir property estimation.

Output or deliverable

Integrated interpretation figures, reservoir property maps, channel indication visuals, and a careful explanation of sandstone shale contrast in the Talang Akar interval.

Skills demonstrated

Reservoir characterization, well log analysis, seismic interpretation, seismic inversion workflows, Petrel, HRS, and subsurface documentation.

Side scan sonar processing and interpretation figures from marine analogue geophysical methods training.

Chapter 04 Featured Case Study

From conditioned seismic data to reservoir property interpretation.

This case study emphasizes calibrated interpretation, not only attractive seismic images. The workflow connects well log review, seismic interpretation, well to seismic tie, sensitivity analysis, and inversion based reservoir property estimation.

Talang Akar Formation case study, stochastic property response and isochron interpretation shown as vertically stacked technical figures.

Interpretation logic

The study began with well log review and seismic interpretation, then moved into well to seismic tie, sensitivity analysis, and general seismic inversion. AI, SI and EEI are used as examples of acoustic and elastic property estimation rather than the only inversion methods considered.

Reservoir meaning

The interpretation focused on low impedance response, Vp over Vs behavior, sandstone shale contrast, and channel geometry indication. The main lesson is that reservoir interpretation needs careful calibration against well data and geologic context.
